Primary router captures the private child before stock fixed-page dispatch.

Main message callback, registered by FUN_00018494 with gdk_input_add (UI thread). Starts the payload's timer, which reads the overlay's key FIFO, without OPTIONS being opened. Prologue push.w {r4-r8,lr}.

bindings.note: 100 32-bit native top-window slots; own child is removed before destroy.

data_writes.note: Cached ENABLE_BD_SRT_TEXT read by FUN_001baf28. FUN_001974c0 then keeps OPTIONS rows 0x3000800/0x3001000/0x3002000/0x3004000 (item types 0x5c-0x5f -> events 0x8eb0/0x8eb1/0x8eb4/0x8eb5) while bdplay reports is_srttext (ctx+0x328c).

libmulang maps the file read-only MAP_SHARED. The two pages holding text IDs 0x12b5-0x12c0 are replaced (mremap MREMAP_FIXED of a private anonymous copy) by the same bytes with each empty column's u16 offset pointing at column 16, the English text. No code, GOT or file change.

external_imports: Resolve libc, CTK/GTK and g_timeout_add/gtk_signal_connect exports through target module dynamic symbols. No loader-side call to GTK or payload init is permitted.
lifecycle: The overlay (Netflix key, remote module) is the same page outside OPTIONS, opened and driven by key presses read from /tmp/ub820_keys.fifo; it ignores the OPTIONS owner and closes with Return or the Netflix key. Owner destroy signal closes child on UI thread; media-kind/media-number/deck-mode or page changes close it; Return restores root focus; OPTIONS closes child and delegates stock exit. One process-lifetime GLib timer runs on the same UI main loop.
